summary: Frontend validation of Meelora rebrand finalisation (PNG logos + dark theme). All 6 acceptance criteria PASS. Login logo (meelora-logo-full.png naturalWidth=1863) and mobile (meelora-logo.png nw=1863) load correctly. Sidebar brand-logo is with src ending in /meelora-logo.png (naturalWidth=1863). Footer app-footer contains src=/meelora-mark.png (nw=506) + '© 2026 Meelora inc.' text. Favicon /favicon.png returns HTTP 200. Dark theme toggle (theme-dark-btn in preferences page) activates .dark on , body bg becomes rgb(15,23,42) = #0F172A navy. Green Meelora accents (#22C55E) preserved on active nav item and buttons. All 5 main navigation routes (nav-dashboard, nav-budget, nav-acct_dashboard, nav-acct_qc9434, nav-journal) load without errors in dark mode. Screenshots confirm no illegible text zones.

issues: Console warning (non-blocking): Recharts container reports width(-1)/height(-1) briefly during dark theme transition — chart still renders correctly after layout settles.

critical_code_review_comments: Recharts ResponsiveContainer warns about width/height=-1 during theme switch — consider adding minWidth/minHeight to the chart container to silence console warnings.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rebrand PNG (logo officiel) + thème sombre Meelora entièrement validés. Sélecteurs: brand-logo (img), app-footer, theme-light-btn / theme-dark-btn (dans data-testid=preferences-page via header-settings-btn). Le mode sombre applique .dark sur <html>, body bg=#0F172A. Backend non testé (skip demandé).
